If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is negative in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is flat, apply a 0.5–1.0% downward adjustment for late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment spikes to 1.0 in the last 2 days, shift forecast downward by 2–3% for the next 5 days regardless of prior trend.  
If sentiment is consistently 0.0 over 5 days and forecast is above 70.0, reduce forecast by 1.0–1.5% for the next 7 days.  
If forecast exceeds true value by >3% in early horizon and sentiment is negative, apply a 2–3% downward correction for the next 10 days.
